training.note: IBM technical post: flagship 30B within the 3B/8B/30B family; all three share the training pipeline, with approximately 15 trillion pretraining tokens. GB200 NVL72 cluster at CoreWeave. Compute and duration are unpublished.
Flagship Pro: the maker states 1.02T total and 42B active parameters, and 27T pretraining tokens using FP8 mixed precision. Compute, hardware and duration are unpublished.

Maker model card for the April 1 Thinking release: approximately 398B total and 13B active parameters, 17 trillion pretraining tokens, and 2,048 NVIDIA B300 GPUs. The reopened Epoch page lists hardware as unknown; the maker identifies B300. Compute and duration are unpublished on this card.
